**Milburn Report to Suggest National Insurance Cuts for Under-25s**
According to an RSS headline and description, an upcoming report by Milburn will suggest gradually reducing employment costs by cutting national insurance for under-25s over a five-year period to create jobs. This is based on a single source; the full article was not fetched, and independent confirmation is not available. No specific numerical projections beyond the five-year timeframe are provided in the source data. This is a single source, not independent confirmation.
